baseline.dedup_review: All 186 CSV names, countries and physical-site keys were read. Full GeoJSON property objects contain no whole-word xneelo, Hetzner, Samrand, iColo, Mombasa, Nairobi, Raxio, Syntys, Q Data or Gulf Data Hub match. This is a name/alias screen, not geometric clearance. No candidate geometry was selected, so full-geometry overlap and physical-campus identity remain open.

capture_policy: One ordinary credential-free request per listed URL, no retry. Six successful content-decoded HTML bodies remain in ignored tmp, each exact byte count and SHA-256 recomputed. The Ooredoo denial body was not retained; only its failure metadata is independently rehashable. Publisher HTML, media, embedded maps and personal-profile content are not redistributed. Compact factual projections only; no open license inferred.

captures.fact: The monthly operator newsletter says its second Samrand Data Centre is now three months into construction and the build continues. It describes no particular newly observed physical operation or phase.

captures.date_basis: Exact SocialMediaPosting JSON-LD datePublished, author and articleBody; not relative age or an activity-ID-derived date.
captures.fact: The earlier original post already describes the second Samrand facility as three months into construction and discusses a first look at its future completed appearance. It is outside the observation window.

The operator lists a Samrand Data Centre at 21 Landmarks Avenue, Centurion, Gauteng, separately from its Durbanville head office. It does not explicitly bind this address to the second facility. Its Samrand Google link has a place identifier but no literal numeric point in the link; no map was fetched or coordinate selected.

Original release announces NBO2 opening on September 7 and describes it as live, built alongside NBO1 and expanding the same Nairobi campus. iColo is transitioning to the Digital Realty brand in Kenya and Mozambique. The complete release text is present in escaped field_template_text data in the captured HTML.
Operator location page explicitly says Nyali MBA2 launched in 2022. Its general expansion-plans wording does not identify a new 2026 physical project.

The dated carrier partnership concerns prospective AFR-IX network deployment through Raxio Angola/Mozambique facilities. The company description explicitly includes both countries among operating facilities. It does not report a named capital-construction operation at either site; future carrier deployment is not selected as current physical construction.

captures.decision: Stopped at first HTTP403. No retry, alternate user agent, authentication, browser attempt, mirror or alternate API used. Search-rendered report text is discovery only, not a successful locally preserved publisher body.

candidate_reviews.name: xneelo second Samrand Data Centre / DC2
candidate_reviews.status_review: The May25 operator newsletter directly reasserts ongoing construction inside the window. However, it retains the same three-month elapsed-build statement already published April13 and supplies no new physical milestone. It is not established whether this is a genuinely fresh observation or a delayed summary. The date is a genuine publication date but is not silently promoted to an accepted physical observation.
candidate_reviews.identity_scope: At most one physical campus is proposed for review. The operator distinguishes first and second facilities but the inspected originals do not prove their exact boundaries or whether they share one physical campus. Do not borrow 21 Landmarks Avenue or the existing JNB1 facility point for DC2.
candidate_reviews.successor_check: Bounded exact-name searches for completion/cancellation returned the February3 original start and its October2026 forecast, plus the April/May updates. No dated completion/cancellation successor was found. This negative search does not prove continuing construction.

new_discovery_routes.basis: Search-visible Haskoning engineer project entry explicitly names Xneelo DC2 / second Samrand Data Centre. June2025-present experience and November2026 deadline are not a physical-work observation. No raw profile fetched and no contractor role normalized.
Search-visible Atana project-manager profile names Xneelo DC2 New Build. Undated project list, not a source locator or in-window observation; no raw profile fetched.

candidate_reviews.next_missing_gate: A public operator/contractor/authority source that precisely binds DC2 to a numeric project locator or exact parcel, with CRS/rights/accuracy handling, plus independent review of the May25 refresh or a genuinely new in-window physical operation. Then perform full186 geometry and physical-campus dedup.
